complexity.notes: Correct but slightly clunky: the elif chain pops the stack during condition evaluation via short-circuiting, which works here but is easy to misread; a constant dict mapping closers to openers (e.g. {')':'(', '}':'{', ']':'['}) plus a single pop/compare would be cleaner. Also, membership testing against the list ['(', '{', '['] is fine (fixed size 3), but a set literal or string would be more idiomatic.
complexity.summary: Classic stack-based validation: push each opening bracket, and on each closing bracket pop and verify it matches the corresponding opener; the string is valid iff the stack ends empty with no mismatch or early pop on an empty stack.
